evidence.curator_note: Book draws 4 arc(s); moves <1,2,3,4> are drawn, move <5> is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Drawn arc 1 = the fishhook printed straight after 'CH3N+.', carrying the nitrogen odd electron into the N(1)-C(6) bond; drawn arc 2 = the arc left of C(6) whose tail sits on the C(6)-C(7) bond and whose fishhook head points back at N(1)-C(6), raising it to N+=C(6); drawn arcs 3 and 4 both point at the C(7)-C(8) bond -- arc 3 has its tail on the C(6)-C(7) bond, arc 4 has its tail on the C(8)-C(9) bond -- so C(7)-C(8) rises from single to double and becomes the CH=CH of the printed isocoumarin. The undrawn move 5 leaves the second electron of the cleaved C(8)-C(9) bond on C(9); the book simply prints the radical dot on that carbinol carbon in the m/z 125 product. Two sigma bonds are cut, C(6)-C(7) and C(8)-C(9), which is what detaches the whole aryl-lactone half of the alkaloid. UNDRAWN COMPANION CHANNELS ON THE SAME EQUATION: the page also prints the complementary charge-retention product, the same aryl-lactone fragment as a radical cation at m/z 190, and its subsequent '-CO' step to m/z 162; neither is given any electron-pushing arrow and no structure is drawn for m/z 162, so neither is encoded here.

Substrate read off the drawing (no name is printed): an N-methylpyrrolidine fused at C(5)-C(6) to a cyclohexene that carries OH on C(9); C(7) of that ring is bonded to a methylenedioxy-benzene and C(8) to the lactone oxygen, the six-membered lactone being C(8)-O(12)-C(13)(=O(14))-c(20)-c(15)-C(7). That gives C17H17NO5 and a molecular ion at m/z 315.1096 (curator-computed; the book prints no molecular-ion mass on this page). DELOCALIZED PRODUCT (convention C): the page prints the m/z 125 ion twice, joined by a double-headed resonance arrow, with an explicit 'or'. The LEFT form -- N+=C(6), exocyclic C(5)=C(11), radical dot on the carbinol carbon C(9) -- is the one the drawn arrows actually produce and is the form encoded here; the RIGHT form (neutral-looking ring N with C(6)=C(5), side chain C(11)=C(9)-OH, and a floating '+.') is the one that carries the printed 'm/z 125' label and is not a localizable Lewis structure. No percentage is printed anywhere on this page, so no relative_intensity is recorded; the prose does call the OE+. (m/z 125 here) the base peak of the corresponding Figure 8.1 spectrum. VALIDATOR ARTEFACT: RDKit's default aromaticity model perceives the 2-pyranone ring of the expelled isocoumarin as aromatic, so the arrow checker reports soft half-bond-order notes on bonds (7,8), (8,12), (12,13), (13,20) and (7,15); the book draws that ring with a localized CH=CH and C=O, and the encoded arrows build exactly that Kekule form.

No MØD rule is cross-linked: rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no key '8.69' (its chapter-8 keys stop at 8.14), so no Rule.fromDFS encoding claims this scheme. No cross-link is asserted and no rule was tested against this substrate.
